notes.title: Damageless Glitch Fixed and General Adjustments
notes.content:
- Improved certain boss fights
- First level has additional tutorial text
- SFX adjustments
- Increased points you get from defeating enemies
- Opacity has been reduced for lanes you are not on for better clarity of the lane you are on
- Removed some obstacles in a few levels
